chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Chicago vacation, the Savoy and choosing Cleveland over the Arcadia
summary: They play the Savoy; Meyer Davis wants them at the Arcadia, but Trent takes the Cleveland Plantation job so New York bands cannot raid the men.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: FROM CANADA YOU MUST HAVE COME DOWN INTO CLEVELAND. YOU NEVER DID PLAY IN CHICAGO DID YOU.
All of us went to Chicago.
(Inaudible) IF YOU TOOK A VACATION IN CHICAGO, YOU WOULD HAVE BEEN RIGHT ACROSS THE RIVER IN WINDSOR. YOU DIDN'T PLAY DETROIT EITHER DID YOU? DIDN'T YOU PLAY IN NEW YORK AROUND THAT TIME?

We came in to play at the Savoy. That's when Meyer Davis wanted to put us in the Arcadia. The Arcadia was the number two ballroom in New York at that time. Of course, Roseland was the number one ballroom and, but in those days Roseland and the Arcadia were real jobs.

So we had the opportunity of going, staying in New York and playing in the Arcadia or going to Cleveland and playing the Plantation. The reason Trent prevailed upon everybody to take the job in Cleveland, he was afraid that the different bands in New York would steal the men. I know I had a couple of offers to go into bands there, yes I did. Two or three of the other guys had offers.
